bugs.title: Signup form shows blank white screen instead of error when email is already registered
bugs.description: Submitting the signup form with an email that's already registered crashes the page instead of showing a validation error.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: ["Open the signup form.","Enter an email address that is already registered.","Fill in the remaining required signup fields.","Submit the form."]
bugs.expected: The form displays an error message indicating the email is already registered.
bugs.actual: The page goes blank (white screen) with no error message shown.

bugs.title: Double-clicking Save creates duplicate test case records
bugs.description: Clicking the Save button twice in quick succession on the new test case form creates two identical records instead of one.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: ["Go to the /test-cases page and click \"+ New Test Case.\"","Fill in all required fields.","Click the \"Save\" button twice in quick succession."]
bugs.expected: Only one test case record is created.
bugs.actual: Two identical test case records are created.

bugs.title: Suite reorder drag handle has no keyboard alternative
bugs.description: The test suite detail page's drag-and-drop case reordering only works with a mouse, with no keyboard-operable way to reorder cases.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: ["Go to a suite's detail page at /test-suites/:id.","Try to reorder the cases using only the keyboard (Tab, arrow keys, Enter)."]
bugs.expected: Cases can be reordered using the keyboard alone.
bugs.actual: There is no keyboard-operable way to reorder cases; only mouse drag-and-drop works.

bugs.title: Search bar returns zero results for valid query strings
bugs.description: The search box on the Test Cases page (/test-cases) fails to filter and display matching test cases. Typing any valid search term causes the results table to collapse to a single "No test cases found." row and the pager to read "Page 1 of 1 (0 total)", instead of listing the test cases whose titles actually contain the term. Confirmed this is a frontend-only failure: calling the backend endpoint directly (GET /api/test-cases?search=search) still correctly returns the 2 matching records, so the UI is discarding valid results rather than the API failing to find them.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: ["Go to http://localhost:5173/test-cases.","Confirm the unfiltered list shows 11 test cases, including \"Search returns no results gracefully\" and \"Search box trims leading and trailing whitespace\".","Click the \"Search by title...\" box and type: search","Observe the results table and the pager count below it."]
bugs.expected: The table should show the test cases whose titles contain "search" (2 matches: "Search returns no results gracefully" and "Search box trims leading and trailing whitespace"), and the pager should read "Page 1 of 1 (2 total)".
bugs.actual: The table shows a single row reading "No test cases found." and the pager reads "Page 1 of 1 (0 total)" — zero results — even though 2 test cases with "search" in the title exist. This reproduces for every non-empty search query tried, not just this one term.
bugs.environment: Chrome via Playwright MCP, local dev build (localhost:5173)
